messages:
mike: Heads-up — planning a tarmac pin tonight 03:00 UTC. Target: runtime v2.4.1 + api v1.8.0. Console change is a feature-flag flip only. Before we lock, need router compatibility sanity for header ordering + new kernel batching. @sarah @jj can you confirm no KV handshake regressions? deploy-bot is prepping a dry-run.

deploy-bot: dry-run scheduled in 30m. Will enforce freeze 15m before window. /deploy status: no migrations pending.

sarah: Did a quick staging run. Router + runtime mostly OK but saw intermittent 502s when kernel path switches to quantized batching. Log snippet: ```
ERROR 2026-03-23T01:12:03Z router: upstream 502 runtime header-order mismatch (expected v1, received v2)
at router.handler -> runtime.request -> runtime.kv
```

jj: Router team: header-split flag itself is fine for api v1.8.0, but runtime v2.4.1 changes internal header ordering under burst batching. I can ship a short-lived tolerant shim in router to accept either header order, then remove it post-rollout. Can canary to two nodes.

mike: Rollback plan: if error rate >0.5% sustained over 5m, roll runtime back to v2.4.0 first. If errors persist after that, enable router shim permanently and evaluate router rollback. @oncall-sre, confirm these SLO triggers?

oncall-sre: Acknowledged. I'll set ChatOps alert: errors >0.5% for 5m -> notify #incidents + page PD. Also will attach a short-runbook to the alert with the rollback steps. Please add `router-shim=true` to release notes so SEs and support know.

console-eng: We'll push a UI advisory during rollout and add the shim flag to release notes. Also adding a console-side probe to validate header ordering on the fly.

jj: Starting router canary (2 nodes). Watching p95 and error rate; will report in ~6m.

deploy-bot: dry-run complete; canary started (2/2). Full rollout ETA 20m after green.

sarah: Canary shows a small p95 increase (~30ms) on KV hot paths but error rate stable. If p95 >200ms for 3m, mark for rollback.

mike: Locking pin window 03:00-03:30 UTC. No other pins allowed in that window. Drafting release note: "runtime v2.4.1 — kernel batching & quantization optimizations; api v1.8.0 — relaxed header parsing; router — optional compatibility shim (auto-expire 1h)."

jj: Shim will auto-expire 1h after rollout. Tagging rollout metadata with `#shim-flag` and adding console probe.

sarah: LGTM :thumbsup:

oncall-sre: Pager on standby. Escalate per alert thresholds.

mike: Thanks all. If anything unexpected, hit this thread and we'll follow rollback steps.
